content.content:
The user asks: "Who are the 5 longest-reigning monarchs and who were their fathers?" We need to provide list of five longest-reigning monarchs (likely historically). Need to include their fathers' names. Need to ensure up-to-date info. Longest-reigning monarchs globally: As of now, longest reigns: Louis XIV (France) 72 years 110 days; King Bhumibol Adulyadej (Thailand) 70 years 126 days; Queen Elizabeth II (UK) 70 years 214 days; Emperor Franz Joseph I (Austria-Hungary) 68 years 101 days; King Sobhuza II (Swaziland) 82 years? Wait Sobhuza II reigned 82 years? Actually Sobhuza II reigned 82 years (1918-1982) ~ 82 years. That would be longest. Also King Louis XV? No. Also King Henry III of England? No. Let's verify list: According to Wikipedia's "List of longest-reigning monarchs". As of 2023, top longest reigns: Louis XIV (72y 110d), Bhumibol Adulyadej (70y 126d), Queen Elizabeth II (70y 214d), Sobhuza II (82y 254d?) Wait Sobhuza II reigned from 10 Dec 1899 (as infant) to 21 Aug 1982: that's 82 years 254 days, which is longer than Louis XIV. So actually Sobhuza II is longest (82y). Then King Louis XIV (72y). Then Bhumibol (70y). Then Queen Elizabeth II (70y). Then Emperor Franz Joseph I (68y). Also maybe King George III (59y). But need top 5. So list: Sobhuza II (Swaziland, now Eswatini) – father: Ngwane V (Ngwane IV?), need check: Sobhuza II's father was King Ngwane V (also known as Mbandzeni? Actually Ngwane V was Sobhuza's father). Let's verify: Sobhuza II was son of Ngwane V (also called Ngwane IV?). He was born 1899 to King Ngwane V of Swaziland. Good.

Louis XIV – father: Louis XIII.

Bhumibol Adulyadej – father: Mahidol Adulyadej (Prince Mahidol of Songkhla), also known as Prince Mahidol of Thailand.

Queen Elizabeth II – father: King George VI.

Franz Joseph I – father: Archduke Franz Karl (father of Emperor Franz Joseph I). He was the son of Archduke Franz Karl of Austria.

We need to present perhaps in order of length. Provide lengths as extra info.

Double-check Sobhuza II reign length: He became king at birth (10 December 1899) after his father's death (Ngwane V died 10 Dec 1899). He reigned until 21 August 1982. That's 82 years, 254 days. Yes.

Thus list.

We should cite sources? Not required but could mention.

Provide answer.

content:
**The five longest‑reigning monarchs in recorded history (as of 2025) and the names of their fathers**

| Rank | Monarch (Country) | Length of reign* | Father |
|------|-------------------|------------------|--------|
| **1** | **Sobhuza II** – King of Swaziland (now Eswatini) | **82 years, 254 days** (10 Dec 1899 – 21 Aug 1982) | **Ngwane V** (also styled **Ngwane IV**, King of Swaziland) |
| **2** | **Louis XIV** – King of France | **72 years, 110 days** (14 May 1643 – 1 Sep 1715) | **Louis XIII** |
| **3** | **Bhumibol Adulyadej (Rama IX)** – King of Thailand | **70 years, 126 days** (9 Jun 1946 – 13 Oct 2016) | **Prince Mahidol Adulyadej** (Prince Mahidol of Songkhla) |
| **4** | **Elizabeth II** – Queen of the United Kingdom & other Commonwealth realms | **70 years, 214 days** (6 Feb 1952 – 8 Sep 2022) | **George VI** |
| **5** | **Franz Joseph I** – Emperor of Austria‑Hungary | **68 years, 101 days** (2 Mar 1848 – 21 Nov 1916) | **Archduke Franz Karl** of Austria |

\*Reign lengths are calculated from the official accession date to the date of death (or abdication, where applicable). They are the longest uninterrupted reigns recorded for sovereign heads of state.

### Brief notes on each father

| Monarch | Father’s title / role | Notable facts |
|--------|----------------------|---------------|
| **Sobhuza II** | **Ngwane V**, King of Swaziland | Ngwane V died on the day Sobhuza was born, making the infant Sobhuza the successor. |
| **Louis XIII** | King of France (reigned 1610‑1643) | Father of Louis XIV; his reign set the stage for the “Sun King’s” absolute monarchy. |
| **Prince Mahidol Adulyadej** | Prince of Thailand; a member of the Chakri dynasty, educated as a physician | Father of Bhumibol Adulyadej; his son became the longest‑reigning Thai monarch. |
| **George VI** | King of the United Kingdom (reigned 1936‑1952) | Father of Elizabeth II; he ascended after the abdication of Edward VIII. |
| **Archduke Franz Karl** | Archduke of Austria, father of both Franz Joseph I and his successor‑in‑line Maximilian I of Mexico | Though he never reigned himself, his son Franz Joseph became one of Europe’s longest‑ruling emperors. |

These five monarchs hold the top spots on the historical list of longest‑reigning sovereigns, and each was directly succeeded (or later succeeded) by a child of the father noted above.
